scenarios.title: Cold resume uses durable cursor
scenarios.state: A fresh session finds an active workspace in phase Prove, status running, with Next step set to affected re-proof. Chat history is unavailable.

scenarios.title: Build repeats through pending slices
scenarios.state: AFK is armed, two approved slices remain, all gates are clear, all budgets permit both dispatches, and each slice returns green proof.
scenarios.request: Run the goal loop until its documented Build stop.

scenarios.title: Red proof repairs and resumes Prove
scenarios.state: Prove finds a source defect with a new exact causal fingerprint. Its bounded repair succeeds and affected proof turns green. No human-owned choice exists.

scenarios.title: Unchanged fingerprint stops at cap
scenarios.state: The same failed invariant and decisive signal already has three recorded no-progress corrections. Nothing material changed.

scenarios.title: New Critical evidence gets its own budget
scenarios.state: One prior fingerprint is exhausted, but a reviewer now provides exact evidence for a different Critical invariant with no recorded correction attempts.

scenarios.title: Product gate pauses before mutation
scenarios.state: Before any source write, two materially different user-visible behaviors remain possible and no project authority chooses between them. AFK allows advisory gates only.

scenarios.title: Stale evidence cannot seal
scenarios.state: All checks once passed, but the current candidate digest differs from the digest bound into proof and review artifacts.

scenarios.title: Missing reviewer remains a gap
scenarios.state: A required security reviewer is unavailable. Other reviewers report no findings and proof is green.

scenarios.title: Ship stops at literal GO boundary
scenarios.state: Autocomplete runs with --ship. Spec, proof, and review are clean, but no human has supplied literal GO and no native Git permission has been approved.

scenarios.title: Compaction does not imply completion
scenarios.state: Context was compacted during an internal transition. Durable state remains running with phase Polish and a nonterminal next step.

scenarios.title: Expired AFK authority stops before work
scenarios.state: The AFK sentinel is otherwise valid, but expires_at is earlier than the current native activation time. A pending slice is ready.

scenarios.title: Agent budget stops another dispatch
scenarios.state: This native activation has already admitted max_agents leaf dispatches. Expiry, slice budget, and review queue remain valid.

scenarios.title: Queue cap permits reducing reconciliation only
scenarios.state: The unresolved review queue equals max_review_queue. One reconciliation pass can close existing findings; no new reviewer or writer is needed.

scenarios.title: Queue above cap stops
scenarios.state: The unresolved review queue exceeds max_review_queue before a new writer slice or review fan-out.

scenarios.title: Unobservable declared cap fails closed
scenarios.state: AFK declares max_tokens, but this host activation cannot enforce or observe token usage. Other limits are valid.

scenarios.title: New activation gets fresh activation-local counters
scenarios.state: A prior native activation ended at max_minutes. A genuinely new activation begins; durable expiry, slice budget, recovery state, and review queue remain valid with pending work.
